historical_sample.reason: zero strict post-decision/post-latency executable completed legs and a v2/v3 rule-version mismatch

baseline.name: frozen_v3_entry_plus_frozen_rebalance_exit_constants
baseline.entry_decision_source: the selected event candidates emitted by consensus_v3_2026_07_16 after event locking
baseline.sizing: 100-share FOK paper order walked against the first separate post-latency ask book

activation.forward_start_source: activation_utc in the signed/hash-locked baseline lock
activation.fixed_end_rule: first of 100 completed registered independent clusters or 180 calendar days after activation
activation.interim_reporting: operational counts, missing-evidence counts, process health, and safety only; no PnL ranking, parameter changes, optional stopping, or promotion

registered_arms.single_change: reject the paired paper entry unless post-latency full-quantity ask depth has both VWAP and marginal price at or below 0.25
use the greatest whole-share FOK quantity not exceeding baseline quantity whose depth-walk cost plus protocol fee plus one adverse tick per share is at most 10 USD and meets market minimum order size

at the first registered five-minute decision where full-quantity contemporaneous bid VWAP is at or below 75 percent of entry VWAP, capture a separate post-latency sell book and paper-exit the executable quantity; residual shares remain open

universe_and_independence.registry: all rows emitted by each sequential v3 depth run, including rejected rows, missing books, selected candidates, no-trades, unresolved and settled lifecycles
universe_and_independence.entry_selection: the exact current v3 selected candidate map after one-bucket-per-event locking
universe_and_independence.cluster_rule: same social account with overlapping market resolution or exposure windows is one cluster; mutually exclusive buckets and rebalances are one lifecycle
universe_and_independence.primary_unit: independent cluster, never leg or snapshot

timing_and_execution.decision_book: raw public CLOB payload persisted by the depth collector with endpoint, HTTP status, request start, response receipt, provider timestamp and SHA-256
timing_and_execution.paper_order_latency_ms: maximum of 500, decision-book RTT, and documented taker delay when present
timing_and_execution.fill_book: first separately requested public CLOB payload whose request starts no earlier than decision complete plus paper latency
timing_and_execution.fill_model: FOK full-depth walk; no midpoint, top-mark extrapolation, later convenience mark, or invented fill
timing_and_execution.partial_exit_rule: record executable partial exit and retain residual inventory
timing_and_execution.identity: condition_id, selected token, outcome label and raw-book market/asset identifiers must agree
timing_and_execution.fees: archive raw clob-markets/{condition_id} and fee-rate?token_id responses; require tbf/base_fee agreement, fd.e=1 and explicit fd.r; fee equals shares times fd.r times p times (1-p), rounded to five decimals
timing_and_execution.fee_failure: missing, ambiguous or inconsistent metadata makes the arm row execution-ineligible and net_capturable=false
timing_and_execution.stress: repeat accounting with two adverse ticks per filled share

evidence_failure_policy.primary_sensitivity: assign each post-signal evidence failure the negative of that arm's planned worst-case event risk

statistics.primary_estimand: mean net PnL per registered independent cluster
statistics.paired_estimand: mean candidate-minus-baseline net PnL over the identical registered cluster universe; rejected candidate entries are retained as zero-PnL paired outcomes
statistics.hypothesis_family: six one-sided tests: absolute expectancy and paired uplift for each candidate arm
statistics.confidence: 50000-resample cluster bootstrap, deterministic seed 20260720, one-sided Holm-adjusted 95 percent lower bounds
statistics.economic_threshold: net PnL divided by committed risk at least 0.02 per cluster and positive under two-adverse-tick stress

promotion_gates.public_record_net_capturable_markouts: separate pipeline; remains zero and receives no credit here
promotion_gates.live_transition: not authorized by this protocol; paper-only remains mandatory even after a pass until a separate explicit user decision and safety review

amendments: any substantive rule, universe, execution, clustering, fee, statistical or stopping change creates v4 and resets the forward sample
